notes.decision: Translated 'seated below.' ϩⲙⲉⲥⲧ is the Lyc. qualitative of ϩⲙⲟⲟⲥ 'sit, dwell' + ⲁⲡⲓⲧⲛ̄ 'downward.' Spatial-cosmological idiom for the lower-placed archons.
Translated 'being squeezed' as qualitative of reduplicated ϩⲱϫϩⲱϫ 'press, oppress, constrain.' Fits the bond-imagery (ⲙⲡ̄ⲣⲉ ⲉⲥⲛⲁϣⲧ 'strong bond').
Translated 'desire of heart.' ϣⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧ = 'pleasure/desire of heart' — the will-direction of the archonic powers operating downward.
'Father of Life' — Manichaean cosmological title; here likely the Father of Greatness (Father of the Living) in his role of establishing the hidden cosmic structure.
'One who hides' — ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲧϩⲉⲡⲧ (causative of ϩⲏⲡ 'hide'). Forms an agent-noun parallel to ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.'
Translated '[gave] him kingship.' Uses the established idiom ϯ ⲡⲟⲣⲟ 'give kingship/establish as king' from the glossary; ⲛⲉϩ = Lyc. 'to him' (= ⲛⲁϥ).

Translated 'the establishment that was lacking.' ϣⲱϩⲧ = 'be wanting, deficient.' Fits Manichaean theology: the King of Darkness's kingship is established only on a defective register, contrasted with First Man's true kingship.
Tentatively 'bond of agreement.' ⲧⲟⲁⲧ uncertain — possibly Lyc. variant of ⲧⲱⲧ 'agreement, persuasion' (cf. ⲡⲓⲧⲱⲧ in vocab). Could alternatively reflect a possessive 'her bond.'
Read as ⲛ̄(ⲥⲉ)ϩⲱⲝⲛⲉ = 'and they fail/cease' (= ⲱⲝⲛⲉ from glossary). Eschatological: the cosmic structures fail in the Great Fire.
Translated 'and they will rescue him forth.' Read as ⲛ̄ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲍⲙϥ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ (assimilation of ⲙ) — ⲛⲁⲍⲙⲉϩ from vocab = 'save, rescue.' Refers to the rescue of light from the dissolving cosmos.
Translated 'too is shut up.' ϩⲱϩ = emphatic 'also/too' (Lyc. ϩⲱⲱϥ). ⲟϣ likely from ⲱϣ 'bind, fasten, shut up' — paralleling 'in the bond and the chain.'

Translated tentatively 'the prison(?).' Lexeme uncertain. Possibly = ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ 'the Zone/Girdle' (Greek ζώνη — see vocab) with ϩ/ⲍ alternation, fitting the Manichaean cosmology where captured archons are bound in the zodiacal zone after the Third Ambassador's coming. Alternative: a Coptic term for 'fastness/enclosure.' Flagged for further investigation.
Translated 'those taken (in).' Past relative + ⲱⲡ/ⲧⲱⲡ 'gather, take in.' These are the captured archonic powers awaiting inspection — fits the simile of the king inspecting his prisoners/works.

Translated 'chiefs.' Compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲣ̄- ('do/make') + ⲁⲡⲉ ('head') = 'head-doer' = chief/foreman. Parallels ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' Fits the inspection-of-craftsmen simile: foremen reporting to the king.

Translated tentatively 'they have given life to.' Reading ⲁⲩ-ⲭⲱⲛϩ where ⲭⲱⲛϩ = ⲱⲛϩ̄/ⲁⲛϩ 'live, give life.' The artisan giving life to his works fits the simile. Alternative: 'they have completed/laid out' (cognate with ⲕⲱⲛϩ 'complete'). Confidence moderate.
Translated 'arrays.' Greek loanword παρεμβολαί 'encampments, arrays, formations' — what the king inspects alongside the works. Standard military-administrative term.
Translated 'when he came forth.' ⲛ̄ⲧⲁⲣⲉ-ϩ-ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ — temporal + 3sg.m + 'come' + 'forth.' The forth-coming of the Third Ambassador to inspect the cosmos.
Translated 'spread forth.' ⲥⲏⲣ qualitative of ⲥⲱⲣ 'scatter, spread, disperse' + ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'out, forth.' Paired with ⲉⲩⲥⲙⲁⲛⲧ 'established' — the works are both established and spread out.
